NCOMPLR

Here is the alpha version of my hypertext rendering of NCOMPLR. The code originally comes from SAILDART. Currently most comments and quoted data are not shown, which I recognize makes this not very useful for reading NCOMPLR. I also haven't implemented PROG tag links yet. Lastly, the integers are generally in the wrong radix. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ If someone wants to write a Maclisp reader for me in Racket, it'll get done quicker.

Five classes of symbols are distinguished typographically.

  • special variables
  • normal variables and functions
  • system functions
  • built-in syntax
  • everything-else

Functions and non-special variables are hyperlinked to their binding occurrences. System functions link to the relevant entry in Kent Pitman's Maclisp manual.

End-of-line characters in symbols are rendered as “⏎”; spaces are rendered as “⋅”. Instead of lambda, and, and or, I display λ, ∧, and ∨.
